notes: Roots & Rockets now runs on the public multiplayer server. Explore three Earth towns and three Moon towns; claim one town, grow detailed crops, trade real goods and meet working neighbors. Each person or workplace has its own menu. Follow the optional First day, Grow food, Make & deliver and Moon life tutorials from B → Tutorial. Delivery crews use physical vehicles with braking, turning and arrival-gated unloading. Tree-lined roads link Earth towns. Moon settlements have repaired roofs and compact service paths; real terrain casts crater shadows and the photographic sky continues through space travel. Shared accounts, private bags and town claims persist on the server. Offline careers stay separate. Apply the signed update and restart: the server and every player must use 0.6.0 / protocol 12. Bootstrap 3 is retained; installations older than 0.4.10 require the full installer.
